MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held today, i.e. Tuesday, 14th July, 2026, at the registered office of the Company. The Board, inter alia, transacted and approved the following Business.

1. Approved the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
